Left methoxy/aryl part: methoxy C-O bond 1, O-aryl bond 1, six ring edges of the benzene ring 6, aryl-P bond 1, subtotal 9. Central phosphorus part, bonds not repeatedly counted: P=S double bond counted as 1 bond, P-S bond 1, P-O bond 1, subtotal 3. Right cyclic imine part: O-C connecting bond 1, C=N double bond counted as 1 bond, the remaining four edges in the five-membered ring 4, subtotal 6. The total is 9 + 3 + 6 = 18.

method.method_draft: Visually partition the structure and count non-hydrogen bonds in each part. Left methoxy/aryl part: methoxy C-O = 1, O-aryl = 1, six bonds around the benzene ring = 6, and aryl-P = 1, subtotal 9. Central phosphorus substituents not already counted: P=S = 1, P-S = 1, P-O = 1, subtotal 3. Right cyclic iminium part: O-C attachment = 1, C=N double bond = 1, and the remaining four edges around the five-membered ring = 4, subtotal 6. Add 9 + 3 + 6 = 18.
